newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Tuesday. No sales of slaughter steers or heifers confirmed at the close.
Inquiry and demand were light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 7400 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Bids 66.00, asking prices 68.00-69.00.
Last price established 67.00 on Thursday, March 20.
